Don't decide based solely on the change in average cost; separate whether you are struggling against air swarms or high-health single units, and compare both card details and diagnosis results.

14勝・10敗・1分なら、14 ÷ 25 × 100 = 56%です。引き分けを: With 14 wins, 10 losses and 1 draw, the calculation is 14 ÷ 25 × 100 = 56%. Excluding draws or using a different period changes the result, even for the same player.

登録前の戦績はすべて見られますか？: Can I see every battle from before I registered?
